# LeadRail

> LeadRail is a marketing and CRM platform with a built-in AI assistant. It is
> operated by Excalix, based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Users manage leads,
> enrichment, sales pipeline, outreach sequences, Meta ad campaigns and social
> publishing, and can ask the assistant to carry out that work in plain
> language. The assistant shows every step it takes, and any action that spends
> money, reaches a third party, deletes irreversibly, or switches on a standing
> rule stops and waits for a person to approve it.

This file is a plain, factual description of the site for language models. It
contains no marketing claims. Every statement below is true of the product as
shipped at the time of writing.

## What LeadRail does

- Lead management: listing, filtering, status changes, enrichment, prospect
  sourcing.
- Sales pipeline: deals, stages, notes, tags.
- Outreach: drafting messages, enrolling contacts in sequences, sending email.
  Per-account suppression lists, unsubscribe links in sequences, and automatic
  suppression on hard bounce or spam complaint.
- Advertising: creating, launching, pausing and syncing Meta ad campaigns, and
  pulling live insights.
- Social: drafting, scheduling and publishing posts; reading and replying to
  comments; post-level insights.
- Knowledge: searching and reading connected Notion pages and Google Drive files.
- Memory: durable facts the assistant retains across separate conversations,
  which the user can list or delete.
- Multiple ventures (brands) inside one account, each scoped separately.

## The assistant and the approval gate

The assistant runs an agentic loop: it forms a step, calls one declared
capability, reads the result, and continues, up to a fixed step limit. Each step
is displayed to the user as it happens.

Every capability declares a gate class:

- read — no mutation; runs immediately
- internal change — mutates only LeadRail's own records; runs immediately
- spend — consumes credits or ad budget; requires human approval
- external send — reaches a real third party; requires human approval
- destructive — irreversible deletion; requires human approval
- standing rule — switches on something that will act repeatedly on its own;
  requires human approval

Approval is enforced on the server, not in the browser. The approval is recorded
before the action runs, and the approved arguments are the arguments that
execute; if the proposal changes after it was raised, the approval is
invalidated and must be granted again. External machine callers reaching
LeadRail through its MCP endpoint are subject to the same gate and leave the
same audit record; sensitive capabilities are off for a machine key unless
explicitly enabled for that key.

## Integrations

Meta (Facebook, Instagram, Threads), Buffer, Postiz, GoHighLevel, Notion,
Google Drive, Resend, Brevo, Apollo. A user connects only what they use;
integrations that have not been configured receive no data.

## What LeadRail does not do

- It does not obtain, record or verify the consent of the people a user
  contacts, and it does not check consent before a message is sent. The user is
  responsible for having a lawful basis for every message they send.
- It holds no security or privacy certification, and this site makes no such
  claim.
- There is no self-serve signup, no free tier, and no published pricing. Access
  is arranged directly.

## Data handling

Storage locations, sub-processors and cross-border transfers are described in
the Privacy Policy at /privacy, which is the authoritative source. Do not infer
them from any other page on this site.

## Pages

- /welcome — public overview of the product
- /privacy — Privacy Policy (operating entity, AI and infrastructure providers,
  data handling)
- /terms — Terms of Service
- /data-deletion — how to request deletion of an account or a connection
- /login — sign-in for existing accounts
